text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just moments before running in the Leopard Stakes,
Hokko Tarumae was showing slight traces of nervousness...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Social media is full of supportive messages from her fans and the people of Tomakomai. Showing her these should help ease Hokko Tarumae's nerves.
choice_data_list: ...Why don't you take a look at the messages from your supporters?
...Why don't you take a look at the messages from your supporters?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much.
But I'll be all right.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I am nervous.
I'm scared of putting in a half-baked run. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I had made up my mind. In this Leopard Stakes, I was going to give it my all with my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To the people of Tomakomai...
I want to show them my strength and put their minds at ease.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Please have faith and watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Watch as the dirt Umamusume, Hokko Tarumae,
takes flight here in Niigata today...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer,
I will carry this tension alongside her and face the race.
I reaffirmed that resolve just now……!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“—There's going to be a big shift in today's race.
Is it... me? Or Tarumae?
No, maybe both.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I need to take a close look and see
just how big the gap is between me, having just finished my debut, and Tarumae!
